teaching_notes: Guide students through this interactive tool. Encourage exploration and discussion. Start with Learn mode to walk through the systematic approach (adding to both sides, dividing both sides). Then let students test understanding in Practice mode (5 MCQs covering procedure, computation, verification, and conceptual understanding of inverse operations). Use Real World mode to connect to the weighing scale analogy from Section 7.1. Finally, Hands On mode lets students discover the solution through experimentation.
instructions_for_student: Solve 5x - 4 = 7. Add 4 both sides: 5x = 11. Divide by 5: x = 11/5. Verify: 5(11/5)-4 = 7.
